note: Demo prices for the concept prototype. Edit freely; the agent and the page only ever use the numbers in this file.

items.name: Renew your hosting plan early
items.description: Extends the current plan at today's price for the chosen term. Longer terms cost less per month.

items.name: Turn on auto-renew
items.description: Renews the plan automatically with the saved card so the sites never go offline.

items.name: Free domain (included with your plan)
items.description: One .com, .net or .online domain free for the first year, then 15.99/year.

items.name: .com domain
items.description: First year price, includes free WHOIS privacy.

items.name: Connect a domain you own to a website
items.description: Points the domain at the website and issues a free SSL certificate.

items.name: Free business mailbox (included with your plan)
items.description: 1 mailbox on your own domain, free for the first year.

items.name: Business Email (per mailbox)
items.description: 10 GB mailbox on your own domain.

items.name: Business Email with AI (per mailbox)
items.description: Mailbox plus AI that drafts replies and sorts your inbox.

items.name: Turn on CDN
items.description: Serves the site from servers near each visitor. Included in Business and Cloud plans.

items.name: Daily backups add-on
items.description: A backup every day, kept for 14 days. Already included in Business and Cloud plans.

items.name: 100 AI credits
items.description: Credits for the AI website builder, AI agents and AI email.

items.name: 500 AI credits
items.description: Best value pack: 20% cheaper per credit than the 100 pack.

items.name: Email marketing Starter
items.description: Newsletters and automations for up to 1,000 contacts. Free for the first year.

items.name: VPS KVM 2 (2 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, 100 GB NVMe)
items.description: Your own server for apps, automations (n8n) and AI agents.
